sea-p3-dlr-singapore-50mw-20260824.summary: The dateline is 24 August 2026. Digital Realty states that Singapore has three operational data centres with approximately 84 MW of combined capacity. The operator metro page identifies those three as SIN10, SIN11 and SIN12; its 2020 release identifies SIN12 as the third and explicitly places it adjacent to SIN11 in the Digital Loyang campus. This is a current operational observation for the existing two Loyang buildings. The separate planned Jurong Island fourth facility and the aggregate 84 MW are not assigned to the Loyang record.
